evidence: The film density was determined from a combination of XRR and mass measurements. The film delamination can be attributed to large stresses in the film. These results show that thermal precursor composition did not contribute strongly to the ALD GPC in the studied temperature window. The resistivity of the Ru films was determined by measuring the sheet resistance on full wafers with a KLA Tencor RS100 four-point prober in combination with the XRR film thickness. The resistivity of films thicker than ~15 nm deposited on SiO2 was about 16 µΩcm, slightly lower than for the films on TiN (19 µΩcm).
